⇒ 31(Jan) + 28(Feb) + 31(March) + 30(April) + 31(May) + 30(June) + 31(July) + 31(Aug) + 30(Sep) + 31(Oct) + 19(Nov) = 323 odd days.

Total odd days → 65 + 323 = 388 days = 388/7 = 55 week and 3 odd days.
